chronoseries.label: Holocene (Extant) (0 Ma)
chronoseries.predecessor: Bombyx mandarina, pre-domestication Holocene (~0.005 Ma), comparative melanin-stripe pitch 96 µm. Not a second member of this one-point series.
chronoseries.what_changes: At 0 Ma and 41 µm the domestic diffusivity pair makes σ(k) positive only in a band around 41 µm. The ancestral 96 µm pitch is linearly stable (σ < 0), so the selected epidermal ring is 55 µm shorter than the mandarina contrast pitch. No later chronospecies exists in this series.

equations: σ(k) = ½ (tr_k + sqrt(tr_k² − 4 det_k)), tr_k = fu + gv − (Du + Dv) k²
boundary_conditions: Dispersion assay: periodic line of length several λ_c
Ocellus: axisymmetric, no-flux at r = 0 by symmetry; far-field fade at the card edge

parameters.steady_state: u0 = a + b, v0 = b / u0²
parameters.note: Du and Dv are scaled together so argmax σ(k) lands on 41.0 µm. They are not taken from any sibling Bombyx slot.

empirical_claims: Yamaguchi et al. 2013 (10.1038/ncomms2778): periodic Wnt1 expression, under ecdysteroid control, generates the twin-spot markings of Bombyx mori larvae.
Yoda et al. 2014 (10.1038/ncomms5936): Apontic-like modulates several larval colouration patterns in Bombyx.
Turing 1952 and Gierer & Meinhardt 1972 supply the wavelength-selection law. Neither paper, nor Yamaguchi 2013, reports a 41 µm measurement. 41 µm is this slot's cellular detail scale.
The canonical ocellus card carries a 100 µm scale bar. Its dark-ring pitch is measured in the script and is allowed to differ from 41 µm.

ocellus_card.role: Scale-appropriate specimen for the 41 µm comparison

adult_habitus.role: Adult museum specimen; not the cellular-scale fitness target

reported_in_source: Wnt1 is expressed periodically in Bombyx larval epidermis and is required for twin-spot markings (Yamaguchi et al. 2013).
A short-range activator and a long-range inhibitor can select a finite wavelength (Turing 1952; Gierer & Meinhardt 1972).
reconstructed_in_script: Schnakenberg Jacobian and σ(k) calibrated so the maximum-growth wavelength is 41.0 µm.
Axisymmetric Galerkin sideband (polynomial envelope plus Fourier rings, including the 41 µm carrier) fitted to the ocellus card.
Predecessor contrast: σ(2π/96 µm) < 0 < σ(2π/41 µm).
transfer_boundary: Segment-scale Wnt1 spots in Yamaguchi et al. are millimetres across. Applying the same wavelength-selection law at 41 µm is a scale transfer, not a measurement those authors published.
does_not_claim: That 41 µm or 96 µm was read off a fossil or off a published micrograph of Bombyx mandarina.
That the adult CC0 habitus photograph is a cellular-scale ocellus.
That a fully nonlinear 2D spot field was fitted pixelwise to the card. The rendered field is the axisymmetric Galerkin projection plus synthetic grain.
